jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default

Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right. Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!

We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here!

Purpose of the role

As a Backend Engineer in Marketing Technology you will be responsible for building our key components of our marketing technology stack. You will drive software design and implementation likewise while helping a newly formed cross-functional team. You will interact with key stakeholders in the Business Units, Software Development, Marketing, Sales and more to understand requirements and use cases while keeping the bigger picture in mind.

If you’re a self starter and results-driven backend engineer, and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, this is a great opportunity to play a pivotal role in a fast-growing company. You will have a concrete impact on the future of the business as a whole.

What you will do

  • Research, plan, scope, evaluate and implement our MarTech stack using Python and PHP

  • Help and train the engineers of our business units to integrate sdk's we provide

  • Own MarTech maintenance, including updates, enhancements, security, and privacy of the systems

  • Help teams identify where technology can help increase conversion, efficiency and user experience

  • Be a point of contact when it comes to technical solutions in the MarTech space and be the key person when it comes to technical questions about the stack

Job requirements

  • Demonstrable experience in building high-quality systems

  • Experience building scalable solutions with Python or PHP

  • Solid understanding of SQL

  • Solid understanding of HTTP/REST, including both developing and consuming Web-based APIs

  • Proven capability in integrating different in-house built systems with off the shelf products

  • A curious, passionate, and growth-oriented mindset

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and influence at all levels of the organisation

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities, and deliver high-quality software solutions on time and on budget

  • Ideally you already had some touchpoints with marketing technology in the past.

 

What We Offer

  • Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here)

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex 
 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 
 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience 
  
 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
  
 Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.
  
 We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.
  
 If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.
 At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

 Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

 We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

  
 Here's what you can expect to be working on 
 Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

 Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

 Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

 Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

 Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

  
 You should apply if:

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager for Live Experiences
jobs.description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. 

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? 

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience? 

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

As part of the Fever Originals team, you will leverage data, market insights, and strong commercial instincts to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that enable people to enjoy unforgettable moments. Our goal is to develop and scale innovative experiences while building strong relationships with venues, partners, and industry stakeholders.

Who you'll work with

You will join our office in Berlin, working closely with internal teams while directly engaging with partners, providers, and venues across the market.

In this role, you will play a key part in growing Fever’s pipeline of original events. A significant part of your work will involve identifying, developing, and negotiating partnerships with venues and external stakeholders, while collaborating cross-functionally with departments such as Marketing, Operations, and Finance to bring experiences to life.

The team you will join is young, ambitious, and highly collaborative, composed of top profiles from companies such as McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros. Team members bring diverse cultural backgrounds and share a strong entrepreneurial mindset.

About the Role: 

As a Senior Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets.
You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic experiences. 

When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:

jobs.title: Product Manager (m/w/d) – Digital Wealth Management (apeiron)
jobs.description:
Über Uns 
 Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis. 
 Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit. 
 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech. 

 Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, Gemini sowie Design-Software wie Figma, um Analysen, Nutzerflows, Produktideen und erste Prototypen schneller zu entwickeln. 

 Du entwickelst die Produkt Roadmap für apeiron und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams detaillierte Produktanforderungen, User Stories und Abnahmekriterien. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen im Unternehmen sowie mit externen Partnern und weiteren Interessengruppen zusammen und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit ihnen ab. 

 Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen. 

 Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. 

 Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen. 

 Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei. 

 
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium. 

 Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld. 

 Du bringst Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im deutschen Vermögensverwaltungssystem mit, idealerweise im Umfeld unabhängiger Finanzberater:innen oder Vermögensverwalter. 

 Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus. 

 Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Claude for Design, Framer, Grafana, Brevo oder Figma. 

 Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen. 

 Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen. 

 Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch. 

 Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen. 
 

 Warum Ginmon? 
 Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität. 

 Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine. 

 Beteiligung am langfristigen Erfolg von Ginmon durch ein Virtual Employee Share Option Program (VESOP). 

 Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments und Nutzung unserer Plattform; 

 Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten. 

 Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts mit High-End-Equipment und optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung. 

 Regelmäßige Teamevents und eine angenehme Büroatmosphäre (Snacks, Getränke, Firmen-Merch u. v. m.). 

 Erstattung deiner Internetkosten und der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket. 

 Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
